resources.string: Records this app process. Background services keep recording; a new process starts a new log. The page refreshes every second. Disconnected devices, observed IPs, times and final traffic remain in this session. Storage is bounded; older entries may be removed with a visible count. WireGuard has no continuous connection state: its duration is an observation window, and the latest handshake is not the first connection time.

Device IPs are masked by default. Private keys, passwords, Tokens and full configurations are excluded. Copy and Save use the same snapshot currently displayed. Full IPs are private: do not share publicly. External file providers may back up exported files. Screenshots are blocked on this page.
